correctness.rationale: Reconstructed PG(2,3) from 13 projective points and 13 four-point lines. Line incidence identities force minimum nontrivial blocking-set size six, with t1=6,t2=3,t3=4 and four triple secants in a no-three-concurrent four-line frame. PGL(3,3) orbit count 5616/24=234. Independently enumerated all 6-subsets of the 13 points and applied the blocking/nontrivial tests; obtained exactly 234 states. Independently constructed all single-point swap edges, obtaining six neighbors per state, 702 edges, and BFS layers (1,6,24,72,116,12,3) from every one of 234 vertices. Verified every adjacent pair shares exactly two frame lines in the package checker derivation; a separate dual-frame checker in the actual tree provides a second exhaustive construction. Finite exhaustive enumeration is a proof for this specific 13-point plane, not extrapolation to other orders.

originality.rationale: Qualified PASS: the six-point blocking-set minimum and frame classification precede this work. The new assessed claim is the labeled minimum-set one-point exchange graph, exact degree, uniform layer profile, radius and diameter, and shared-two-lines rule. Earlier small-plane classifications give vertices, but do not on their accessible statements specify these graph metrics. The closely relevant 2022 classification full text was unavailable, so overlap in its appendix/computational tables remains a substantial risk.
